structuredContent.body:
The fixed exterior views had excessive fine grain, and Chromium audio capture ran behind real time even when the existing Mobile Safari route kept the production clocks aligned.

This change lowers the default grain and composite uniform from 0.035 to 0.012, with the exact source and generated root bundle saved together. F3 retains its required check name and every existing core, WebKit and fault-recovery step. It now also requires actual Mobile Safari recording, matching source/run/attempt provenance, all three original media files, and the unchanged three-clock guard. The aggregate passes only when both core and Safari succeed.

Validated before this PR:

- C30 controlled grain capture passed all eight fixed views: scene values and all buffer bytes matched, and original PNGs and descriptors restored exactly. All 16 before/trial images were inspected; road cracks, wall pits and brick joints remain visible.
- The locked CI build reproduced bundle 6b887bc1, then generated the two-line candidate and verified source/root agreement. New bundle SHA256: `81c93f3bf6c45b14c25f0e742a78d19b8dc70dca665ebba897bb6e39bbc937b3`.
- Original C29 Safari report and all three MP4s were recovered and verified byte for byte. Independent integration checks passed 30 audio controls and 19 workflow checks, including 36 aggregate-result cases. Old-build evidence is rejected by the new build pin.
- F2 canonical-state alignment and strict SESSION serialization fixes are included; prior failures and original evidence remain recorded.

Reviewed source: `0abe4628947064fe811ed842face2018b87d5bf5`. Independent review and adoption records are under `AI_DEVELOPMENT/EVIDENCE/CONTINUOUS-2026-09-14/c31-integration/`.

The PR's actual required CI, simulator run and round comparison must pass before normal merge. Audio listening, reference comparison and all 19 element verdicts remain not measured; this is an incremental product and validation change.

Floor-Review: C / pass
